reviews.text: The best groomer in Oslo. She is very good at her job and very nice with the dogs.
My friend looked super nice after getting a haircut❤️ He used to get stressed at other hairdressers, but it's clear that he was very well taken care of at Tatiana😊 …
My Cockapoo has been with Tatiana for 3 years now. She is incredibly skilled, calm and nice with the dog. The results are always very good. Can't praise her enough!
Our cobberdog Ruby always looks great after a visit to Bark and Shine. We find that Tatiana takes her time and is thorough. Recommended

Our first meeting with a dog groomer today! Our 6.5 month old Bishon Havanese became so beautiful after a visit here!!! We didn't want him to be super short, and were afraid we would regret it as he has a very nice coat. No regrets at all! Just as soft and good after the clip, smells lovely, doesn't seem stressed despite the fact that he is skeptical of new people! So thank you so much for the fantastic treatment of our best friend ❤️

Tilly has been to Tatiana's today and she was great! We groomed her and even with the more difficult coat (due to shaved lower half after surgery) Tatiana did a great job! Tilly also seemed comfortable and less stressed than she usually has been elsewhere. Tatiana took her time and listened carefully to our preferences and wishes. I love that there is only one groomer working so there is not a lot of noise and distractions and unnecessary stress for my dog ​​during an already stressful situation. 10/10, going back🥰 Already been asked if she is a puppy at 12 years old😂

After a less than successful home haircut, I booked an appointment with Tatiana for my puppy Leo on short notice. This was his first time at the salon, but she was patient and smoothed out his fur. He also got his claws trimmed and a cute teddy bear haircut on his face. We recommend Bark and Shine!
